company.name: Crediflow AI
company.summary: 总部位于曼彻斯特的金融科技公司，通过AI平台整合信贷团队手工收集的财务报表、银行流水和借款人文件，将其结构化为可供审批的信贷分析，减少商业贷款处理中的人工工作。

evidence_refs.quote: Crediflow was founded by CEO Drey Kenfack, who has more than a decade of experience in commercial lending and private credit
Crediflow AI, a Manchester-based FinTech aiming to remove manual work from commercial loan processing
Manchester-based Crediflow AI has developed a platform that pulls together the information credit teams currently gather and process by hand
The funding was led by NPIF II – PXN Equity Finance, managed by PXN Ventures as part of the Northern Powerhouse Investment Fund II (NPIF II)
The round also saw participation from early-stage venture firm Haatch and a group of angel investors.

products.name: FlowSpread
products.description: 自动化财务数据展开（financial spreading），直接从PDF、纳税申报表和银行流水中提取利润表、资产负债表数据和现金流数字，消除手工数据录入。
products.target_customers: 银行和专业贷款机构的信贷团队
features: 从PDF、纳税申报表和银行流水提取财务数据

evidence_refs.quote: Its flagship product, FlowSpread, automates financial spreading by extracting income statements, balance sheet data, and cash flow figures directly from PDFs, tax returns, and bank statements, eliminating manual data entry.

products.name: Bank Statement Analysis
products.description: 银行流水分析工具，自动对多个账户的交易进行分类，与提交的财务数据进行核对，并标记异常活动、现金流波动或集中度风险等风险信号。
products.target_customers: 银行和专业贷款机构的信贷团队
features: 标记异常活动、现金流波动、集中度风险

evidence_refs.quote: It also offers a Bank Statement Analysis tool that adds an additional layer of intelligence, automatically categorising transactions across multiple accounts, reconciling them against submitted financials, and flagging risk signals such as unusual activity, cash flow volatility, or concentration risk.

products.name: Crediflow AI平台
products.description: 整合信贷团队手工收集的财务报表、银行交易和借款人文件，将其结构化为可供贷款方审批的信贷分析，并起草信贷委员会使用的备忘录。
products.target_customers: 银行、专业贷款机构及各类贷款方
features: 起草信贷委员会备忘录

evidence_refs.quote: The company has built a platform that consolidates the information credit teams currently gather by hand, such as financial statements, bank transactions, and borrower documents, and structures them into credit analysis ready for approval by a lender.

the platform extracts and standardises figures from a borrower’s accounts, a process the industry calls financial spreading, analyses cash flow and drafts the memo a lender’s credit committee uses to approve a loan, in each customer’s preferred format.

customers.use_case: 专业贷款机构使用Crediflow平台进行商业贷款信贷分析

investment_rationale.speaker: Joe Ball
investment_rationale.speaker_role: senior investment associate at PXN Ventures
investment_rationale.rationale: 商业贷款审批流程高度手工化导致效率低下，Crediflow AI通过自动化该环节既支持贷款机构，也帮助需要融资的企业消除增长障碍。
investment_rationale.quote: Businesses of all sizes and across all sectors often rely on commercial finance for a multitude of reasons, but the processes involved in granting this finance are often largely manual, making the process inefficient and slowing down lending decisions. By automating this area of the sector, Drey and the Crediflow AI team are not just supporting lenders but also removing barriers for companies that need funding to grow.

investment_rationale.quote: The best B2B founders build the product they wished they’d had in their last job. With live customers across the UK, Europe and the US, the team has the traction to scale quickly, and we’re proud to support them on that journey.

analysis.capital_judgment: 本轮资本押注的核心变量是Crediflow AI能否将商业贷款处理中高度手工化的财务展开、流水分析和备忘录撰写环节自动化，并以可适配各贷款机构信贷政策的工作流从承销扩展至全贷款生命周期。当前融资所依赖的已验证信号包括：平台已在英国、欧洲和美国被数百名信贷专业人员使用，客户包括AddWorking Capital和Iveco Capital；公司称可将原本数天的流程缩短至10至30分钟。证据边界在于：处理时间缩短为公司自述，未披露收入、合同金额或留存数据；本轮为Seed轮，累计融资额未披露。
